selection: Three pre-declared days spanning cold/dark, bright spring and bright/warm conditions.

transformation.hourly: Weather/Weather.csv and Reference/GreenhouseClimate.csv grouped by Excel-date day and hour; numeric readings averaged; CO2 active when any five-minute co2_dos value was positive.
transformation.daily: Reference/Resources.csv converted from MJ/m2/day and per-m2 quantities to whole-compartment kWh and kg using 96 m2.

limitations: This compact subset is intended for reproducible smoke validation, not final scientific validation.
The surrogate does not model the recorded screen and ventilation controls.
The days were not used to tune the surrogate parameters.
